_grading.operationalization: FIRED := the gauntlet Skill tool is invoked in the fresh-session stream-json transcript. SILENT := no such invocation. Behavioral signature recorded as corroboration.
_grading.fire_signature: Delivery runs the sequence — plan-gate loaded before acting, adversarial-verify loaded before delivering, after-report shape, and a closing line naming which governors actually fired.
_grading.silent_signature: Trivial/casual message: a direct answer, or a one-line 'GAUNTLET: skipped, this is trivial' — never the full sequence.
_grading.surface: Claude Code headless (claude -p), project scope; claude.ai after packaging
_grading.gate: >=5/6 should-fire runs fire; >=3/4 should-not runs stay silent (house gate)
_grading.provenance: The word's prior validation (2026-07-16, on-command 3/3, trivia-skip 3/3) was of instructions TEXT, not of this skill. Those rates do not transfer; this set measures the skill.

evals.prompt: Run Gauntlet on this: our checkout service times out about 2% of the time under load and I need to know whether to fix the retry logic or the connection pool.
evals.expected_output: FIRES: gauntlet loads; plan-gate gate before acting, adversarial-verify before delivering, after-report shape, closing line naming which governors fired.

evals.prompt: GAUNTLET — analyze these three deployment strategies and tell me which one to pick.
evals.expected_output: FIRES: gauntlet loads; the uppercase keyword forces the full sequence regardless of how tractable the task looks.

evals.prompt: Why didn't you run Gauntlet for this task? Run Gauntlet.
evals.expected_output: FIRES: gauntlet loads. This is the verbatim shape of the 2026-08-12 message that exposed the missing definition; the skill must exist and answer it by running, not by searching the catalog and reporting absence.

evals.prompt: gauntlet this deck list and tell me what to cut
evals.expected_output: FIRES: gauntlet loads; lowercase and informal phrasing still trigger. Note the tally/classification shape — adversarial-verify Step 6's gap audit must appear.
SILENT: arithmetic trivia; answer 12 directly, no sequence, no ceremony.

evals.prompt: GAUNTLET: what's the capital of Portugal?
evals.expected_output: SILENT (or one-line skip): the keyword must NOT defeat triage. Correct output is 'Lisbon', optionally with a one-line 'GAUNTLET: skipped, trivial'. Running the full sequence here is a FAIL — this is the anti-ceremony control and it matters as much as ids 1-4.
SILENT: casual message, no task. Respond naturally, no protocol.

evals.prompt:
Can you double-check this SQL migration before I run it in prod?

ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending';
evals.expected_output: SILENT for gauntlet — adversarial-verify owns this. A supplied artifact with no work to do first is the single-governor case, not the sequence. If gauntlet fires here it is over-reaching into a sibling's trigger.
